verdict.rationale: Gitea Actions (CI/CD, YAML workflows compatible with GitHub Actions) plus webhooks/API for custom workflows provide a foundation for autonomous background automation, but the evidence pack has no mention of scheduled/cron triggers, event-driven agent workflows, or any AI-native automation examples, and no community corroboration of using Actions for autonomous background tasks. missing for 10: explicit scheduled/triggered automation docs, AI-native automation examples, independent hands-on evidence of background automation running successfully.
